title: A REQUEST_CRAFT intent with an unknown or missing recipe id raises KeyError instead of being refused
summary: REQUEST_CRAFT with an unknown or missing recipe id is refused with a FAILED_REQUIREMENTS: unknown_recipe trace instead of raising KeyError; PROG-097 verified; world hashes identical at 1000t.

title: The history API's summary mode returns the whole cognition graph and reports zero node/edge counts
summary: History snapshot summary mode drops the nested graph and returns the writer's node_count/edge_count; one page held in memory; docs name the real snapshot file.
